comment: DB-08 group-durability receipt vectors, generated by ncogearthchain gossip/ddb TestGroupDurableReceiptVectors (DDB08_UPDATE_VECTORS=1). The SDK copy (nec-node-sdk tests/vectors/db08_receipt_vectors.json) must be byte-identical.

cases.name: under quorum by weight: B+C+D
cases.why: 3 of 13 by weight; three of four members would pass a count of signers

cases.name: below the distinct-signer floor: A alone
forged signature: B's signature has one bit flipped
wrong epoch: signed (and labelled) for epoch 6, committee is epoch 7
cases.why: the receipt names an epoch that is not the committee's

cases.name: wrong network: signed for network 0xa0a, verified on 0xfa3
cases.why: the network id is in the digest

cases.name: tampered payload hash after signing
cases.why: the signatures cover the payload hash

cases.name: non-member signer: A + E
cases.why: E is not in the committee
